title: Truffade Adder
description: Inspired by the Bugatti Veyron, the Truffade Adder is one of the fastest straight-line hypercars in Los Santos, featuring an iconic aerodynamic rear wing.

title: Progen T20
description: Based on the McLaren P1, the T20 features an active hydraulic rear wing that raises at high speeds and tilts forward as an airbrake during hard deceleration.

title: Pegassi Zentorno
description: Aggressive Lamborghini Veneno-inspired styling with hexagonal heat-shield rear louvers that make the rear window completely bulletproof against small arms.

title: Överflöd Entity XF
description: Modeled after the Koenigsegg CCX, the Entity XF boasts legendary high-speed traction and mid-engine stability through tight high-speed corners.

title: Grotti Turismo R
description: A hybrid hypercar blending LaFerrari and McLaren P1 DNA, delivering instant electric motor throttle response and exceptional track downforce.

title: Grotti Cheetah
description: A low-slung, wedge-profile Italian supercar inspired by the Ferrari Enzo and Pagani Zonda with gullwing-style rear engine access.

title: Pegassi Infernus
description: A staple of the GTA franchise modeled on the Lamborghini Murciélago, featuring signature scissor doors and center-mounted triple exhaust.

title: Pegassi Osiris
description: Inspired by the Pagani Huayra with gullwing doors, twin-turbo V12 engine, and all-wheel-drive that provides instant launch control.

title: Annis Elegy RH8
description: A Nissan GT-R counterpart renowned for its sophisticated AWD computer system that practically glues the car to the road through wet asphalt and asphalt chicanes.

title: Bravado Banshee
description: The quintessential Dodge Viper tribute with high-displacement V10 power, broad oversteer tendencies, and unmistakable twin racing stripes.

title: Pfister Comet
description: A rear-engine German performance icon based on the Porsche 997 GT2, featuring explosive acceleration paired with a lively oversteering rear axle.

title: Dinka Jester
description: A futuristic hybrid sports coupe reminiscent of the Acura/Honda NSX concept, combining sleek aerodynamics with confident all-wheel drive.

title: Karin Sultan
description: A fan-favorite four-door tuner heavily inspired by the Subaru Impreza WRX and Lexus IS300, capable of seamless tarmac-to-dirt rally performance.

title: Vapid Dominator
description: A roaring American muscle icon modeled on the fifth-generation Ford Mustang, demanding throttle discipline to prevent spinning the rear wheels.

title: Bravado Gauntlet
description: A modern muscle coupe styled after the Dodge Challenger, offering balanced handling and brute V8 power utilized extensively in heist getaways.

title: Declasse Sabre Turbo
description: A vintage 1970s Chevrolet Chevelle tribute complete with an exposed shaker hood intake option and high-torque quarter-mile punch.

title: Pegassi Bati 801
description: Modeled after the Ducati 848/1098 sportbike, the Bati 801 is one of the most agile two-wheel vehicles, capable of sustained high-speed wheelies.

title: Dinka Akuma
description: A stripped-down streetfighter motorcycle based on the Buell XB12S with nearly unrivaled zero-to-sixty acceleration.

title: Maibatsu Sanchez
description: The quintessential off-road dirt bike capable of scaling Mount Chiliad cliffs, leaping sand dunes, and conquering rugged mountain trails.

title: Nagasaki Buzzard Attack Chopper
description: A light military scout helicopter equipped with twin miniguns and lock-on missile pods, ideal for rapid aerial traversal across the map.

title: JoBuilt P-996 LAZER
description: An F-16 Falcon-inspired military fighter jet stationed at Fort Zancudo, armed with dual explosive cannon rounds and heat-seeking air-to-air missiles.

title: Mammoth Hydra
description: A military attack jet equipped with VTOL (Vertical Take-Off and Landing) thrusters, allowing it to hover like a helicopter or cruise at supersonic speeds.

title: Vapid Sandking XL
description: A massive lifted heavy-duty 4x4 pickup truck based on the Ford Super Duty, featuring enormous ground clearance and off-road capability.

title: Benefactor Dubsta
description: A luxury German SUV inspired by the Mercedes-Benz G-Class, combining plush interior status with rugged four-wheel-drive rock crawling.

title: Karin Rebel
description: A battle-hardened 1980s Toyota Hilux 4WD pickup favored by Blaine County survivalists for its indestructible frame and baja rally modifications.
